status.label: Covered by the Keyboard Manager RDP tracking issue
status.detail: This nested CloudPC/RDP key-remapping failure fits the existing RDP issue family tracked by #21258 and its primary tracker #9337; no separate fix is proposed.

judgment.rationale: The report concerns a local Right Ctrl-to-Left Ctrl remap producing stuck or unexpected keys only in nested remote CloudPC sessions. The broader open issue #21258 tracks Keyboard Manager failures through Remote Desktop, and its designated primary tracker #9337 explicitly states that related RDP issues share a bug class expected to be fixed together. A closed duplicate #13403 was also redirected to #9337. This report has no distinct confirmed fix path beyond that existing tracker.
evidence: The report lists PowerToys 0.80.1 and Windows App 1.3.241.0 and describes intermittent Ctrl/Esc/parenthesis failures in a nested remote CloudPC session while local typing remains normal.
Open issue #21258 tracks Keyboard Manager remapping failures through Remote Desktop and includes multiple key-state and remote-input reports.
Issue #9337 is explicitly designated as the primary tracker for a class of RDP Keyboard Manager bugs expected to be fixed together.
Issue #13403, about original and remapped keys both arriving across RDP, was closed in favor of #9337.
No separate linked fix for the nested CloudPC symptom was found.
judgment.recommended_action: Keep the CloudPC symptom with the existing RDP tracker rather than create a competing fix proposal; reopen separate triage only if a current reproduction demonstrates a distinct non-RDP failure.

fix_assessment.rationale: A separate issue-level fix is not applicable while the symptom falls under the existing RDP class tracker #21258 and primary tracking issue #9337. This does not claim that the RDP problem has been fixed.

issue_context.summary: The user reports local Right Ctrl remapping causing intermittent stuck or unexpected keys only in a nested remote CloudPC session.
known_information: The report lists PowerToys 0.80.1, Windows App 1.3.241.0, and a local Right Ctrl-to-Left Ctrl remap.
The user describes remote-only Ctrl/Esc/parenthesis symptoms and says disabling local Keyboard Manager resolves the behavior.
Open issue #21258 tracks related RDP remapping problems; #9337 is the declared primary tracker for the RDP bug class.
Issue #13403 was closed in favor of #9337 for original and remapped keys arriving together over RDP.
inferences: The nested CloudPC and second-RDP-session details may be a scenario-specific manifestation of the tracked RDP remapping class, but no current reproduction confirms the same low-level mechanism.
issue_context.analysis: The upstream tracker explicitly groups RDP Keyboard Manager failures into a shared class. Preserve the distinctive CloudPC details in this triage record without proposing a parallel implementation or claiming a fix has shipped.
initial_investigation: Read the report and its similar-issue suggestions.
Reviewed #21258, #9337, and #13403; #21258 is open, #9337 is its primary RDP tracker, and #13403 is a closed duplicate redirected to #9337.
